statement: T threads each do K critical sections that increment a plain int; the final count is T*K, critical sections never overlap (no data race), and no thread is stuck forever. Run alone first, lock/unlock works and is repeatable.
contract: struct Mutex { void lock(); void unlock(); };  default-constructible, starts unlocked.
scenario_rule: at least one scenario with re-acquisition (K >= 2) and one with 3 contenders
